notes.title: We're going to gamescom 2025!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We're excited to announce that our team will be attending gamescom 2025 as guests this year. 



We can’t wait to meet fellow developers, players, and fans — and to share more about our game in person.



If you’d like to learn more about our first game Life Souls — let’s connect!



Feel free to message us here or join our Discord if you’d like to meet up or chat during the event.



See you in Cologne!
